entries.title: About
entries.text: About Onifade Ifeoluwa. Product designer specialising in mobile apps, web apps, SaaS dashboards, FinTech and Web3 interfaces. Skills: user research, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, user flows, developer hand-off. Process: Discovery & Alignment → Design & Iterate → Polish & Handoff.
